kicker: Work with me · Independent travel consultant
heading: Latin America, beyond the beaten track.
lead: A partner on the ground for travel agencies: I help you develop Latin America into a reliable and distinctive part of your portfolio, from the first idea to the group in the field.
heroAlt: Colonial arches in Antigua, Guatemala, with a volcano behind
aboutAlt: Vuk walking past cacti above the Colca Canyon
aboutHeading: Travel as a way of understanding the world.
about:
For almost three years I have travelled independently across the Americas — by local buses, trucks, boats, trains and on foot.

Latin America is a land I understand first-hand: its culture, history, landscapes, people and the realities of travelling there — from border crossings and night buses to small family-run guesthouses and the markets where the day begins.

I want to help agencies build more thoughtful Latin American programmes: authentic, but also workable.

servicesIntro: The partnership is modular: your agency picks the part of the process it needs help with — or the whole journey, from first idea to the field.

services.title: Trip development
services.text: Research and programme design, from idea to finished itinerary: choosing routes, pacing the trip and tailoring it to your audience.

services.title: On-the-ground coordination

destinations.name: Guatemala
destinations.text: Volcanoes and living Maya traditions. Colonial Antigua, jungle with caves and turquoise rivers, and Lake Atitlán ringed by volcanoes.

destinations.name: Bolivia
destinations.text: Snow-capped peaks, the high altiplano, endless salt flats and the Amazon — for travellers drawn to space, altitude and silence.

destinations.name: Argentina
destinations.text: Vast distances and contrasts, from the red canyons of the northwest to Patagonia's lakes and glaciers, and Buenos Aires.

sampleHeading: Guatemala: volcanoes, jungle and the Pacific

sampleFacts.label: Route
sampleFacts.text: Antigua — Acatenango — Semuc Champey — Lake Atitlán — El Paredón

sampleDays.text: Arrival in Guatemala City and transfer to Antigua.
Antigua: colonial town, market, coffee and an acclimatisation hike.
Acatenango climb, a night on the slopes facing active Fuego.
A long travel day through Alta Verapaz to Lanquín.
Semuc Champey: turquoise pools, river and jungle caves.
Lakeside villages, boat crossings and weaving cooperatives.
Down to the Pacific: El Paredón, black sand and sunset.
A morning on the coast and transfer to the airport.

sampleNote: An illustrative example, not an offer: no prices, suppliers or confirmed availability. Every programme is developed and checked together with the agency.
